UI_FBR_YouAreIn: You're standing in a %1, so it opened there.
UI_FBR_PickRoom: Pick a room, then click an item to place it.
UI_FBR_NoItems: Nothing here. Try another category or search.
UI_FBR_Hint_place: Click: place   R: rotate   Right-click or Esc: done   Ctrl+Z: undo
UI_FBR_Hint_floor: Click: fill the whole room   Drag: paint a rectangle   Right-click or Esc: done   Ctrl+Z: undo
UI_FBR_Hint_remove: Click a piece of furniture to remove it   Right-click or Esc: done   Ctrl+Z: undo
UI_FBR_Hint_strip: Click an item to place it   Wheel: scroll   Category button: next group
UI_FBR_Option_LayoutTip: Catalog window: room tabs, filters, search and a grid of pictures. Bottom strip: eight items along the bottom of the screen.
UI_FBR_Option_AnywhereTip: Place furniture on any square with a floor, even where the game would say no (on top of other furniture, against no wall).
